description: Pre-trade risk validation. Final gatekeeper before any order execution.
checks: Kelly 0.25x position sizing based on PM confidence
VaR 2-sigma: reject if projected loss > daily limit
Correlation check: reject if corr > 0.7 AND total exposure > limit
Daily loss limit: reject if accumulated loss >= HERMES_DAILY_LOSS_LIMIT_PCT
Symbol whitelist: reject if not in HERMES_ALLOWED_SYMBOLS
Max positions: reject if open positions >= HERMES_MAX_POSITIONS
